title: mariscus cephalanthus
intro: Mariscus cephalanthus, commonly known as Cephalanthus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae and is native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing various health benefits, such as lowering blood pressure and reducing inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions like vasodilation and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in Mariscus cephalanthus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant is also used in traditional medicine for its antiseptic and antibacterial properties, which help in treating various infections and promoting wound healing.
